title: DAAST Asset
description: DAAST (Digital Audio Ad Serving Template) tag for third-party audio ad serving

asset_type.description: Discriminator identifying this as a DAAST asset. See /schemas/creative/asset-types for the registry.

duration_ms.description: Expected audio duration in milliseconds (if known)

tracking_events.description: Tracking events supported by this DAAST tag

companion_ads.description: Whether companion display ads are included

transcript_url.description: URL to text transcript of the audio content

provenance.description: Provenance metadata for this asset, overrides manifest-level provenance

macro_declarations.description: One declaration per occurrence in a field carried by this asset. URL-delivered assets declare only locator-URL occurrences; receivers do not infer declarations for tokens discovered later in a fetched document.

delivery_type.description: Discriminator indicating DAAST is delivered via URL endpoint

url.description: URL endpoint returning DAAST XML. Macro delimiters remain byte-preserved and are processed only under attached occurrence declarations.

delivery_type.description: Discriminator indicating DAAST is delivered as inline XML content
